//: Resolution-only tsconfig, read by `bun run knip` (`--tsConfig tsconfig.knip.json`) and by NOTHING else -- it is not a build, gate, or editor program. Its whole job is the `paths` block: knip resolves module specifiers with oxc-resolver under the fixed condition set require/import/node/default, so a bare `@rhombus-std/x` would land on the package's `import` condition (./dist/bundle/index.js) and the scan would see zero references into any library's src. tsconfig `paths` take precedence over node_modules `exports` in that resolver, so mapping the scope back to src pins the analysis to source REGARDLESS of whether dist happens to be built -- the scan reads the same on a cold clone and after `bun run build`. tsconfig.editor.json does the same job for the editor via its `source` export condition; knip ignores customConditions, hence this file rather than reuse.
